overview: Roadie Roster is a hiring and onboarding manager for a new store opening, tracking roadies from sign-up through paperwork, orientation, training and certification.
features: Paperwork checklist in a fixed order: Digital Paperwork, I-9 / W-4, Alcohol Certificate, Policies & Procedures
Checklist items can only be checked in order, with later boxes disabled until the step above is done
The stage tag shows each roadie's latest completed paperwork step while they are Hired
Roster, orientation, crew and card views all show the same step tag
Demo mode with seeded roadies showing a mix of paperwork steps
